conflicts.description: The showcase's mockup shows a 3-tab (Details/Curriculum/Media) layout with a persistent right-hand 'Curriculum' rail alongside the form. The locked product/SCREEN_INVENTORY.md § 21-22 specifies exactly TWO separate tab-screens (Overview, Curriculum) with no Media tab and no persistent split panel.
conflicts.resolution: The locked product spec (rank 1) wins. Overriding it to match the showcase's panel layout would mean overriding a locked functional-spec document with a visual-reference document, which is out of scope for a visual-correction pass. Two tabs, no Media tab, no persistent rail — implemented as locked.

layout.structure: Tabs (Overview | Curriculum) -> single-column form panel, bounded max-width (D49 correction from full-bleed stretch)

content: Save PrimaryButton + Publish/Unpublish Toggle, moved to a prominent action bar at the top of the form (D52) — previously buried after every field, requiring a scroll before the primary action was visible
Content Language Select (independent of UI language)
Thumbnail FileUpload with real CourseThumbnail preview image (D52 — previously text label + checkmark only)

artworkRules: FileUpload's success-state thumbnail preview reuses the same course-artwork rendering as CourseCard (shared/artwork.json) when the uploaded/existing thumbnail resolves through the same component.

states.loading: skeleton form; each Select independently supports "Loading options…"
states.error: inline field validation + Snackbar retry on save failure
states.success: Snackbar "Course saved" — not a full SuccessState (routine, not a milestone)

rtlBehavior: form labels/fields start-aligned; FileUpload dropzone icon/text logical alignment; Select menus open start-aligned to field, trailing indicator at logical end
responsiveRules: form fields stack full-width below Desktop
knownGaps: Media tab / persistent Curriculum rail are an intentional, disclosed, unresolved gap versus the showcase — see conflicts above. This is the largest single driver of this screen's fidelity ceiling.

D52 fix: Save button + Publish Toggle moved to a top-of-form action bar (see sections.actionsTop) — matches the reference's prominent header actions without merging into the shared outer instructor-page header, which would have required lifting form state across components; same save/publish logic, unchanged. D52 fix: the FileUpload success state for the course thumbnail now renders a real CourseThumbnail image preview instead of a bare text label + checkmark, closing the gap this file's own (pre-existing) artworkRules field already called for but was never actually wired up.
